deviations.relative_to_runs_complete: Before (plan 11.2 allows generator fixes found on development tasks)
deviations.what: §3.4 D3 "Monthly activity" is widened from commits and LOC to commits, LOC, distinct authors, lines added and lines deleted per month (raw counts of the same commit set and window; no labels, ratios or thresholds; display names pass the D lint). §3.5 item 3 keeps its rule (add older months until L_D >= 0.90 L_C) and gains a last step: if all window months are used and L_D is still below 0.90 L_C, D2 rows of modules beyond the top K are appended, alphabetical, with the same columns, until the tolerance is met or no module is left. C is unchanged.
deviations.when: 2026-10-06, before `wp5-generator-freeze`, before any sample manifest was generated
deviations.why: On the 3 development tasks the D3 cap of 36 months could not close the gap on 2 of 3 (L_C / L_D = 6173 / 5405 and 5853 / 5172, both outside the 10 % tolerance). After the change: 6173 / 5580 (m = 25), 5853 / 5284 (m = 24), 3643 / 3466 (m = 0); no `length_violation`. D remains a superset of C's facts and carries no interpretation.

deviations.what: Agent terminal state `RepeatedFormatError` (mini-swe-agent exit after consecutive format errors) is accepted as a valid agent termination; the diff is evaluated like any other exit (added to `terminal_states` in `configs/wp5_analysis.yaml`).
deviations.why: Plan 5 listed only Submitted, LimitsExceeded and the wall-time exit. Pilot 1 had 16 of 40 runs end this way, mostly nemotron token cutoffs; refusing them would block the analysis. Not an infra failure: the model, not the API, produced the output. Decided from failure modes only, not from condition differences.

deviations.what: Validation removes PASS_TO_PASS tests that do not pass in all of the 3 gold repeats (and at base) from that task's effective P2P list, and keeps the task, unless more than 10 % of its P2P tests are lost (`p2p_unstable_env`, task dropped) or any F2P test is flaky or failing after gold (task dropped).
deviations.why: Plan 2.1 says a task with a flaky F2P or P2P result is excluded. Dropping on any flaky P2P would remove tasks for environment noise unrelated to the study. Effect: 4 of 148 attempts were dropped as `p2p_unstable_env`; the per-task count of removed tests (`p2p_flaky_n`) is in `validation.json`.

deviations.what: Agent settings: nemotron thinking disabled (`extra_body.chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false`, as in WP2); `max_tokens` 2048 -> 4096 for both models; wall-time limit 900 -> 1800 s; `max_consecutive_format_errors` 3 -> 5. Step limit 40, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95 unchanged.
deviations.why: Pilot 1 (temperature 0.7, 2048 tokens): nemotron hit the token cap 66 times (empty content, reasoning consumed the budget), p0 = 1/20 = 0.05, which is UNINFORMATIVE under plan 7.4. A one-call check confirmed reasoning tokens disappear with thinking off (reasoning_content 201 -> 0 characters, 83 -> 13 completion tokens). A supplementary 8192-token pilot hit the 900 s wall limit. The same settings apply to all conditions. Based on p0 and failure modes only.

deviations.what: Binary file changes are dropped from the agent diff (extract_diff and evaluation).
deviations.why: In pilot 2, 4 runs on one task (qBraid__pyqasm-155) produced a diff containing a spurious binary change to a tracked PNG, which made the whole patch fail to apply (`patch_apply_failed`). The 4 runs were re-evaluated from their stored patches after the fix (all remain unresolved). Concerns patch mechanics only, not conditions.

deviations.what: The power inputs (§7.1: p̂0, model log-OR) are taken from pilot 2 (final agent settings, deviation 4), not pilot 1. Pilot 1 is reported as a pilot only.
deviations.why: Pilot 1 ran with settings that were then changed (thinking on, 2048 tokens), so its baseline does not describe the frozen design. Only condition-A counts are used for p̂0; no A-vs-B comparison was made.

deviations.what: Pellet 2.3.1 explanation calls crash deterministically ("Adding type to a pruned node") for some classes whose definition uses a decimal facet (e.g. stage classes via the 0.15 slope facet; some StableModule explanations). The generator's pre-specified template fallback (§3.6) fills these from asserted values and flags `explanation_fallback`.
deviations.why: Reasoner limitation, not a generator change; SA8 (exclude tasks with any fallback) covers it.

deviations.what: Task `jdmoorman__kaczmarz-algorithms-22` (initial_development) is replaced by `NTNU-IHB__PythonFMU-158`, the next unused initial_development task in the seeded order (numpy `default_rng(20261006)` permutation of sorted ids). The replaced task is recorded under `exclusions` in `wp5_tasks.json` with reason `no_commits_up_to_snapshot`.
deviations.why: The population pipeline returned `unmineable` for the replaced task: its base commit (2020-04-26) predates any complete month of history, so no repository-level measurements exist and C and D cannot be generated. Plan 5 allows replacing a task whose inputs fail before the first run. The design's task-to-repo-to-stage mapping is unchanged (one initial_development task from a single-task repo), so `wp5_power.json` is unchanged. B availability changes from 38 to 37 tasks and scheduled runs from 1112 to 1108.

deviations.what: The power runner `run_wp5_analysis.py power` gains an exponent clamp in `contrast()` (argument limited to +-700), per-cell checkpoints (`wp5_power.json.cells.*.jsonl`) and a `--p0-subset` option; the three p0 values were computed as separate processes and merged by a final run.
deviations.why: The first power run crashed with `OverflowError` in `contrast()` after about 2.6 h, because a quasi-separated simulated fit produced a huge estimate, and lost all results. Simulation, grid, seed and decision rule are unchanged. Up to 118 of 1000 replicates failed to fit in some cells; they are recorded per cell in `n_failed`.

deviations.what: Infrastructure only: API key routing changed from one key per model (nemotron: `NVIDIA_API_KEY_2`, diffusiongemma: `NVIDIA_API_KEY_4`) to a per-call rotation over four keys (`NVIDIA_API_KEY`, `NVIDIA_API_KEY_2`, `NVIDIA_API_KEY_4`, `NVIDIA_API_KEY_5`; round-robin, skipping a key that had a 429 in the last 15 s, and switching to the next key on a 429 before the retry backoff). Workers 3 -> 4 (`limits.max_workers` 4, the VM-wide cap). The job was stopped (SIGTERM) and resumed from the unit checkpoints; 3 in-flight runs (no unit file, no patch, no gzipped trajectory) were discarded with their raw partial trajectories and are redone from scratch. New runs record `keys_used` (env-var names with call counts) and the session metadata records `key_pool_env_names`. Code: `wp5/agent.py` (`KeyPool`), `wp5/runner.py`, `configs/wp5.yaml`.
deviations.when: 2026-10-07, after `wp5-run-freeze`, during the full run (32 runs had completed and been checkpointed)
deviations.why: Decided from 429 counts and throughput only (1099 HTTP 429 in 2 h, about 16 runs/h, 11 runs ended as RateLimitError infrastructure failures), not from any outcome, resolved value or condition-level result. Any key can call any model, so rotation changes neither the model, the prompts, temperature, top_p, max_tokens, step limit, wall time, `extra_body`, the task list, the manifests nor the evaluation. Runs before and after the change differ only in which key authenticated the call and in the concurrency (3 vs 4 runs in flight). The rate-limit infrastructure failures from before the change stay as recorded; they are handled by the plan's infrastructure-failure rule.

deviations.what: Infrastructure only: 3 runs that ended as FINAL infrastructure failures (`exit_status` RateLimitError, HTTP 429 after all client retries, 2 harness retries used; 20 to 76 429 responses each) were redone once more from scratch with the current harness (4-key pool, deviation 10): `cevoaustralia__aws-google-auth-34__A__nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b__r1`, `cevoaustralia__aws-google-auth-34__D__nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b__r1`, `nose-devs__nose2-268__C__nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b__r1`. Their old unit, trajectory and patch files are kept in `/home/adtgrade/research/data/wp5_superseded_infra/` (with the pre-rerun ledgers); the redone runs ended as valid agent terminations (all LimitsExceeded, 0 harness retries). The harness also gained a `drift` subcommand (gold-patch re-evaluation, plan 5; `wp5_gold_drift.json`), which does not touch any run.
deviations.when: 2026-10-07, after `wp5-run-freeze`, after the full run finished and before `wp5-runs-complete`; no outcome had been aggregated by condition, model or stage
deviations.why: The cause was the fixed per-key rate limit that deviation 10 removed. Selection used the terminal state / error type only, before any outcome aggregation, as plan 5 requires (infra failures are retried from scratch). Plan 5's ITT rule applies to whatever is final after this: the final ledger contains 0 infra failures. Note: the number of resolved runs over all 1108 units was seen as a single unconditioned count when checking the evaluation `reason` field for evaluation crashes; no breakdown by condition, model, stage or task was computed.

deviations.what: Gold-drift flags are delivered in a separate file: `wp5_gold_drift.json` (new `run_wp5.py drift` subcommand, same evaluation path as an agent patch). `run_wp5_analysis.py analyze` overlays `gold_drift_fail = true` from that file onto the task rows, because `wp5_tasks.json` is hash-locked in `wp5_run_manifest.json`. Result: 80 tasks re-evaluated, 1 gold failure (`learningequality__ricecooker-394`: 8 of 9 FAIL_TO_PASS pass, in two independent attempts); `rigetti__pyquil-1564` failed once with `env:install_failed` and passed on re-evaluation (transient install error, treated as an evaluation crash under plan 5, so not flagged). The SA9 outcomes file `wp5_outcomes_sa9.jsonl` is produced by `run_wp5.py sa9`, which applies the TBox class definitions (`StableModule = relChurn < Rs and changeMonths <= Ms`, `ActiveModule` = the complement over determined modules) directly to the cached module measures instead of re-running the reasoner per variant; W variants re-cut the cached raw module history. Equivalence on the primary configuration was checked and passed (all 1207 module labels equal the stored reasoner labels; all 1108 recomputed Y3 equal the ledger Y3; `wp5_sa9_check.json`).
deviations.when: 2026-10-07, after `wp5-run-freeze`, after the full run, before `wp5-runs-complete` and before any outcome analysis
deviations.why: The drift check is a pre-registered step (plan 5) that the harness had no command for. Only the delivery path of the flag differs. SA9's plan text says "TBox rebuild and re-reasoning"; for datatype-restriction classes the direct evaluation is equivalent, which the check demonstrates. No analysis logic, model, contrast or threshold changed.

deviations.what: `wp5_run_manifest.json` `hashes.harness_config` (`configs/wp5.yaml`) no longer equals the hash recorded at the freeze, because of deviation 10 (key pool, workers 4). The manifest keeps the original hash and gains a `full_run` block with the final harness commit, the final `wp5.yaml` hash and the ledger hashes. `run_wp5_analysis.py` does not check `harness_config`, so no override was needed.
deviations.why: Deviation 10 is the only cause; recorded here for completeness.
